verdict.rationale: Highnote says its in-house compliance and operations teams run KYC and KYB [highnote-docs-23]. Issuance is gated on an approved account-holder application [highnote-docs-4], and a Document Upload SDK collects identity documents when an application enters manual review [highnote-docs-16, highnote-docs-38], which shows built-in verification with review states. Missing for 10: documented KYC/KYB data requirements, a full enumeration of review states, re-verification flows, and independent corroboration.
